category_title: Pupils with high SNA dependence and learned helplessness
scenario_title: Circle time questioning and prompt dependence
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group circle time activity and is asked to share an answer with the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is your turn to share in circle time. What was your favorite part of the story?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you remember what happened at the end?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I know, I'm trying to think...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You liked the part with the dog. Just tell everyone you liked the dog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Like we do a circle time and I’m just trying to think of the answers . . . and you tell me it!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is your turn to share in circle time. What was your favorite part of the story?

STUDENT: (Stays quiet, looking down) Um...

TUTOR: Do you remember what happened at the end?

STUDENT: I know, I'm trying to think...

TUTOR: You liked the part with the dog. Just tell everyone you liked the dog.

STUDENT: Like we do a circle time and I’m just trying to think of the answers . . . and you tell me it!

task.content: Participating in a 'circle time' activity and attempting to formulate answers to questions.

context.environment: Mainstream primary classroom setting during circle time.
context.social_setting: Group circle time with SNA present.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When a pupil is attempting to process information or answer a question.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Trying to think of the answers but being interrupted by the SNA telling them the answer.
related_quotes: Like we do a circle time and I’m just trying to think of the answers . . . and [the SNA] tells me it

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked a question during circle time.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Trying to think of the answers.
